verdict.rationale: Beamer is a changelog and feedback tool with a roadmap offering, so task-status tracking is a fair question for it. The evidence only lists a "Public and private roadmap" and a communication dashboard. Nothing documents real-time status of in-progress tasks, blockers, or last-update timestamps, and a roadmap listing alone is only adjacent.

support.subject: As a product-manager, I can watch the real-time status of each in-progress task, including what it's blocked on and its last update
